content.comment_body: Third-party USB cable for older [product_name] modules—here’s my experience. Many users seek alternatives to the costly original [company_name] USB cables, so I tried a cable ordered from vhbw via Amazon. The cable comes with a driver CD, but you can disregard it. The CD’s instructions combine Chinese and English, making them confusing. When you connect the cable, Windows detects it but doesn't install device software. In Device Manager, you see an unidentified USB 2.0 device. Attempting to update the driver using the CD fails—the driver isn’t found, and most CD contents are in Chinese, including file names. To resolve this, I opened the adapter’s housing to identify the chipset, finding it was the CH340G. I searched online and found the appropriate drivers. After removing the unidentified USB device, I installed the driver using the setup EXE as an administrator. Installation was successful, and after plugging the cable back in, a virtual COM port appeared in Device Manager. I connected the cable between my PC and [product_name] [article_no]—it worked, even with a [product_name] [article_no] module. The cable fits securely without wobble. The cable costs less than €25 on Amazon. See the following for more information: [url] (Amazon Germany cable), [url] (vhbw cable supplier), and [url] (CH340G chipset driver).

analysis.insight_summary: The user describes how to use a third-party USB cable with older [product_name] modules on Windows. The provided driver CD was largely unusable due to language barriers and missing drivers, so the user identified the cable’s chipset and found the correct drivers online. After installation, communication between PC and [product_name] modules succeeded. This demonstrates common challenges when using third-party accessories, namely unclear multi-language documentation and extra steps required for proper setup.
analysis.user_expectations: The user expected an easy installation and instant setup via the included driver CD for connecting their PC and [product_name] modules, supported by clear instructions and immediate usability.
